author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
Can AI read a spec and build a chip?

I ran an experiment, asked 7 AIs to build 74181 with UVM TB and formal proves, then I cross check them with LEC.

Only Opus and Sol are fully equivalent on LEC.

Sonnet, Luna, GLM got the ALU functions right, but implemented the auxiliary pins wrong.

Deepseek and Kimi are functionally incorrect

Note that on all 7 AIs, the testcase passing rate and coverage are 100%

Will add Astra and Fable to this experiment, stay tuned.

author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

replies.text: 4004 is a bit oddball isn't it? Try a 6502? There's a lot more about that online. I asked Claude to make me a 6502 a few months ago, and that went pretty well. It was coding against known software models and could validate using easily available and well documented toolchains...

author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

replies.text:
4004 (1971) , 6502 (1975)

6502 is more complex than 4004. After I get 4004 working, 6502 is next.
… Coding against a software model is just reverse distilling, even a dumb Sonnet 4.8 can do it 3 months ago. It is a solved problem.

The only think I gave the AI is the spec, the documents of the tools, textbook, nothing else. No skill, no special knowledge from real human hardware engineer. It is the same thing I would give to an human intern.
